title: PlanetBintang REIC Tables · Kamus Digital
description: Server-side PostgreSQL tables used by the Aireber/TanStack Start API. Browser IndexedDB is only an offline fallback, never the production identity authority.

apiContract.POST /api/kamus register|login: Create account or verify password; returns short-lived bearer token once.
apiContract.GET /api/kamus?action=me|collections|fil: Return only the authenticated user's records.
apiContract.POST /api/kamus logout|save-word|save-fi: Mutate only the authenticated user's data.

securityRequirements: Password hashing and verification run server-side using PBKDF2-SHA512 with per-user random salts.
Only SHA-256 digests of opaque session tokens are stored in the database; sessions expire and can be revoked.
Every user-owned query is constrained by the authenticated user ID.
Admin roles are never assigned by the public client.
The API accepts configured origins only; set REIC_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the exact trusted frontend origins.
Configure the public API base URL in leksikon/index.html using meta[name=reic-api-base].
Apply the migration in aireber/netlify/database/migrations before enabling the API.
The current file endpoint stores text content up to 5 MB in PostgreSQL; binary object storage requires a separate storage provider.
